metadata.request: A3 毒性藥劑量基準收尾
metadata.red_line: 寧缺勿造; evidence_pending stays null; no inferred canonical dose.

records.source_backed_statement_zh: 30 g 應標為本方製備批次中的雄黃投料量，不是成人每日單味雄黃劑量。現代資料另記成品每丸3 g、一次1丸、一日1次。
records.source_backed_statement_en: 30 g is a formula-batch ingredient amount, not an adult daily single-herb dose. The same source separately gives a 3 g finished pill, one pill once daily.

per_unit_exposure.reason: The cited source gives finished pill mass but not a final batch yield/count or a validated ingredient assay per pill. Do not infer Xiong Huang per pill from batch composition.

records.source_backed_statement_zh: 現值 `.5-60g` 把不同基準拼成一個範圍，應拆開。2020版成方標準為整批朱砂100 g、製成960丸、一次1丸、一日1–2次。古典《局方》條目另載朱砂二兩，應保留為 classical_text_amount；二手資料括號換算的60 g不能反過來當作原文單位。
records.source_backed_statement_en: The current `.5-60g` range conflates dose bases. A 2020 formula standard uses Zhu Sha 100 g in the batch and makes 960 pills, dosed one pill 1–2 times/day. The classical entry separately gives Zhu Sha as two liang and should remain a classical_text_amount.

separated_values.note: Single-herb Zhu Sha monograph; not a formula-batch amount.

per_unit_exposure.method: explicit batch ingredient input / explicit finished-unit count
per_unit_exposure.interpretation: Nominal apportioned Zhu Sha input per finished pill, not measured systemic exposure or assay content.

records.source_backed_statement_zh: 現值 `1-28g` 無法代表單一可追溯基準。2020版成方標準的整批細辛投料為18 g；2025單味細辛正文的成人通常量為1–3 g，散劑每次0.5–1 g。兩者必須分欄保存。
records.source_backed_statement_en: The `1-28g` field is not a traceable single dose basis. The 2020 formula standard uses Xi Xin 18 g in the batch, while the 2025 single-herb monograph gives 1–3 g as the adult usual dose and 0.5–1 g per powder dose.

separated_values.note: This is a monograph powder-dose instruction, not the amount of Xi Xin contained in one Wu Mei Wan unit.

per_unit_exposure.reason: The formula standard gives 18 g Xi Xin and finished dosage forms, but no explicit final batch unit count/yield. Honey addition is given as a range for one dosage form. Under the no-inference rule, do not calculate Xi Xin per pill.

records.source_backed_statement_zh: 180 g 是現代成方製備批次中的制川烏投料量，不是病人單次或單日制川烏劑量。古典來源保存為六兩，現代資料庫/成方標準另表為180 g。
records.source_backed_statement_en: 180 g is a formula-batch input of prepared Chuan Wu, not a patient per-dose or daily herb dose. The classical text preserves six liang; modern sources separately display 180 g.

per_unit_exposure.reason: The 2020 standard gives honey added per 100 g powder but no explicit final pill count/yield. Do not back-calculate aconite per 3 g pill from an excipient range.

records.source_backed_statement_zh: 180 g 是現代成方製備批次中的制草烏投料量，不是病人單次或單日制草烏劑量。古典來源保存為六兩，現代資料庫/成方標準另表為180 g。
records.source_backed_statement_en: 180 g is a formula-batch input of prepared Cao Wu, not a patient per-dose or daily herb dose. The classical text preserves six liang; modern sources separately display 180 g.

per_unit_exposure.reason: The 2020 standard gives honey added per 100 g powder but no explicit final pill count/yield. Do not back-calculate aconite per 3 g pill from an excipient range.

same_pattern_scan.reason_zh: repo audit 顯示範圍上限30 g；課程材料同時以雄黃30、朱砂30列在整方組成表，且整方製成3 g丸。高度符合「單味日劑量下限 + 方劑批量上限」被拼成 range 的模式。
same_pattern_scan.canonical_action: Do not auto-fix from this A3 pack. Create a follow-up adjudication using a formula-standard source for the exact batch and finished yield.

same_pattern_scan.reason_zh: 課程組成表把朱砂列90 g，同一材料另寫每次服1.5–3 g、每日1–2次，明顯不是把90 g當病人單次量。尚未在本 A3 輪確認 repo 的精確 `dose_g` 值與相同來源鏈，因此只列 suspected。
same_pattern_scan.canonical_action: Verify current repo value and formula-standard source before changing canonical.

same_pattern_scan.reason_zh: repo audit 已記錄朱砂 `3-30g`。這種範圍與2025朱砂單味成人通常量0.1–0.5 g不相容，且上限呈批量尺度；但本輪未取得足以完成磁朱丸批量/成丸收率判定的方劑標準來源。
same_pattern_scan.canonical_action: needs_followup_source; do not infer a corrected value.
